title: Bedrock shafts along the causeway as industrial infrastructure

tellings.quote: So, in in my opinion, that's part of the industrial infrastructure of the Giza Plateau.

plain: Shafts cut into the bedrock along the causeway of Khafre, the long ancient road leading up to one of the pyramids at Giza in Egypt, were part of the plateau's industrial machinery. The researcher Jeffrey Drum gives this as his own opinion on Michels's show, as part of his case that the pyramids sat on top of some kind of energy works.
